title: Lemon-Baked Fennel and Broad Beans
subtitle: with sage, thyme and garlic
description: Soaked and cooked broad beans baked with young fennel, sliced garlic and lemon, finished with chilli and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.text: Soak the broad beans in plenty of water for 12 hours, changing the water halfway. Rinse and drain.

Put the beans in a tall pot with the sage, thyme, 2 whole garlic cloves and plenty of water to cover by a few centimetres. Cook for about 50 minutes until tender (a quarter teaspoon of bicarbonate of soda shortens this). Reserve 1/2 cup of the cooking water and drain.
Towards the end, preheat the oven to 180°C.

Transfer the beans to a wide, deep square baking dish and add the halved fennel, 4 sliced garlic cloves and sliced lemon over and between the beans. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, pepper and chopped chilli and add 2 to 3 tablespoons of the reserved cooking water. Cover with baking paper and bake for about 25 minutes, adding a little more cooking water if the liquid falls below the height of the beans.
Remove the cover, squeeze over the juice of 1/2 lemon and bake for 10 to 12 more minutes until the top is golden.
